generation.scope: All unmarked index-preserving isomorphisms for transverse doublet windows, including both rank-twelve curves, are explicit. For the unordered projective pair p,q the full-rank locus only identifies simultaneous sign. The infinity boundary identifies q up to sign and the zero-sum boundary identifies p up to fourth roots; the two boundaries never meet in the unmarked moduli. Opposite inverses, cubic contractions, alternating gradients and singular kernel determinants certify separation at every exceptional point.
